name: compound-memory
description: Project memory and engineering skills for coding agents in Claude Code and Codex, built to work on a local project first. Twelve skills that each work alone and hand work to one another through files (project-memory, plan, prototype, build, debug, review, verify, ship, autopilot, learn, write, catch-up), plus five shortcuts for the memory commands typed most (grill, handoff, sync, cleanup, repair).
